svg.aria-label: BT appears in public spending under 116 different names.
svg.title: BT appears in public spending under 116 different names.
svg.text: Capita appears under 141 spellings, G4S under 91, and HMRC
itself is paid under 76 — one of them misspelt. No
identifier is published, only free text, so following one
company across the state means untangling every variant by
hand. We did: every match was eyeballed, and 65 ambiguous
ones were thrown out and listed.
analysis/supplier/variants.csv — 18 companies, every variant eyeballed, exclusions in variants_excluded.csv
